correctness.rationale: Exactly 808 nonempty faces obtained by enumerating all subsets of all 16 size-six blocks. An explicit ordered matching has 375 pairs and critical cells one dimension-zero, one dimension-one and 56 dimension-two; all 2736 directed Hasse incidences are acyclic by complete topological sort. Exact signed Morse boundary degrees are 4*(-2),39*0,13*2 (Shrikhande) and 9*(-2),38*0,9*2 (rook). Choosing one degree-two cell yields RP2 and makes the remaining attachments trivial, giving RP2 wedge 55 S2. An independent direct boundary computation gives reduced mod-2 Betti (0,1,56,0,0,0) and mod-3/mod-5 Betti (0,0,55,0,0,0). The verifiers are self-contained and rerun from embedded bytes. Limit: no claim is made for other biplanes.

value.rationale: The 16-point Kummer 2-(16,6,2) design is classical and motivated before any enumeration; its facet/block complex is a canonical topological invariant. Its projective-plane summand and exact fundamental group/torsion resolve precise information not determined by higher-dimensional rook homology, the incidence block table, or general neighborhood theory. Exact finite 2-complex homotopy type with 55 remaining spheres is a substantive structural classification, not a random small count; scripts provide reproducible independent checks. Risk: relevance to broader biplane families remains an open direction, not part of this claim.
